events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The driver cancelled this RydeX trip [F4], so the cancellation fee is tested only through NS-0's driver-cancellation branch, i.e. NS-1/NS-2/NS-3 [NS-0]. The driver asserts the rider was a no-show [F12], which puts the case under NS-1, requiring (i) an "I'm Here" tap, (ii) GPS presence at the pickup when tapping, and (iii) more than 3 minutes of waiting at the pickup thereafter [NS-1].

Requirement (i) is met: the platform timeline records a tap at 14:13:10 [F6], and the driver's chat message at 14:13 corroborates the arrival [F10]. Requirement (ii) is met: at the tap the driver was 39 m from the pickup, inside the 200 m radius [F6][F1][NS-1].

Requirement (iii) fails. The system record shows only 1 min 40 s (100 s) continuously within 200 m after the tap, and the driver cancelled at 14:14:50, about 1 min 40 s after tapping [F6][F4][F5]. The driver's chat claim of having "waited more than 3 min" [F11] and his statement of having waited for the rider [F12] are contradicted by the GPS/timeline records, which control over statements. The cumulative in-radius time before cancellation was 2 min 30 s [F2], and even counting the stationary period 14:12:50–14:14:50 [F3] the driver's presence within the radius at the relevant point never reached the >3 min threshold required by NS-1 (iii) [NS-1].

Because NS-1 (iii) is not satisfied, the $6.61 cancellation fee was not validly incurred and must be refunded in full [F8][NS-2]. No fake "I'm Here" tap occurred — the driver was 39 m from the pickup when tapping [F6][F1] — so the NS-2 flag_account limb is not triggered [NS-2]. The driver's own profile shows 0 upheld disputes and no prior route/no-show findings [F17], and RD-6 concerns route deviation only, so no account flag is added [RD-6]. The 30-day dispute window is satisfied as this is a fresh in-app complaint [NS-7].

Records show only about 1 minute 40 seconds passed before the cancellation, so the fee wasn't valid. We're refunding the full $6.61 as a Ryde voucher on your account. Nothing else is needed from you. Thanks for flagging it and sorry for the hassle.

Our records show the cancellation came about 1 minute 40 seconds after your tap, so the fee didn't apply and the rider's $6.61 is being refunded as a Ryde voucher. No penalty or flag has been added to your account. For future trips, please stay at the pickup and wait past the 3-minute mark before cancelling so a no-show fee can be charged.
